title: Realization of every codec row
statement: For every finite Turing machine $M$, natural numbers $n,s$, and codec row $r$ for $M,n,s$, there exist a Boolean list $x$ of length $n$ and a configuration $c$ of $M$ on input $x$ such that $c$ is in the window of radius $s$ and its codec row is $r$.
